observations.command:
set -eu
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
dmesg | awk '/QDFTcon_GetErrDetStatus|ERR DET Status Debug/ {a[n%30]=$0;n++} END {s=n>30?n-30:0;for(i=s;i<n;i++)print a[i%30]; print "MATCH_COUNT",n+0}'
cat /proc/uptime
